verdict.rationale: Navan's own docs list 'Unlimited policy and approval workflows' and describe transactions being flagged against policy and routed to approvers. That shows a first-party policy-and-approval engine with exception flagging, but the depth of the configuration is unproven. Missing for 10: documented limits configurable by category, role, and context; explicit auto-approval of in-policy expenses with only exceptions routed to humans; any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can codify our expense policy — limits by category, role, and context — so in-policy expenses auto-approve and only exceptions reach a human

citations.quote: understand why a transaction was flagged, who needs to approve it, and what policy applies.
a smart target based on location, date, and demand that's under their policy limit.
